blocks.title: Call for Proposals: Early-Career Grants
lines: **If** your project **addresses** a gap in the literature, **apply** by 15 March. **Unless** you **submit** an ethics statement, your file **will not be** reviewed. **Provided that** your budget **is** realistic, we **will fund** up to €20,000.

**Were** your proposal **to be** shortlisted, you **would be invited** to present. **Had** you **applied** last year, you **would have received** feedback by now. **Should** you have questions, e-mail our office.

body: **Apply in good time.** — Inscrever-se com antecedência.
**Stand a chance.** — Ter chance.
**Make the shortlist.** — Entrar na lista final.
**Fall through the cracks.** — Passar despercebido.
**Put forward.** — Propor.
**Rule out.** — Descartar.
**By the book.** — Seguindo as regras.
**Subject to approval.** — Sujeito a aprovação.
**Yes, unless you forget the ethics statement.** — Sim, a menos que esqueça a declaração de ética.
**What if I’m shortlisted?** — E se eu for pré-selecionada?
**If my project fills a gap, can I apply?** — Se meu projeto preencher uma lacuna, posso me inscrever?

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: A ênfase intencional destaca a palavra que carrega o sentido: sílaba forte, mais longa e mais alta. Mudar a palavra enfatizada muda a mensagem.
